text:
Situation: Somatropin has been on FDA's shortage list since 2023-01-06 and remains listed as of 2026-10-21, a duration of 46 months. Novo Nordisk, Inc. is listed as To Be Discontinued with initial posting date 2025-11-14 and related info stating discontinuation of manufacture. Current stock: Corvale East has 38 cartridges (8.9 days) and 8 syringes (2 days); Corvale General holds 69.91 units (16.2 days) of Eli Lilly NDC 00002814701 and 64.42 units (14.9 days) of Novo Nordisk NDC 00169770321; Corvale Lakeside has 9 syringes (12.4 days).

Why (FDA record): FDA inspection 1167028 at Novo Nordisk A/S - KV ended 2021-11-18 classified VAI, 414 days before the shortage posting on 2023-01-06. FDA inspection 1238387 at Novo Nordisk A/S - Hax ended 2023-06-01 classified VAI, 146 days after the shortage posting. FDA inspection 1341150 at Novo Nordisk A/S - KV ended 2024-05-02 classified VAI, 482 days after the shortage posting.

Our position: The shortage is long-standing and the manufacturer has announced discontinuation. Internal transfer can stabilize Corvale East within days. Alternative suppliers are not on FDA's shortage list today but require verification of supply continuity.

Recommended actions:
1. Transfer 13 units from Corvale General to Corvale East — approved by pharmacy director (transfer request).
2. Evaluate purchase from Sandoz Inc — approved by buyer.
3. Evaluate purchase from EMD Serono, Inc. — approved by buyer.
4. Evaluate purchase from Ferring Pharmaceuticals Inc. — approved by buyer.
5. Evaluate purchase from Pfizer Laboratories Div Pfizer Inc — approved by buyer.

Not recommended: Delaying transfer while awaiting new supplier contracts; relying solely on Novo Nordisk supply given discontinuation posting.
